
## Discuss Summary (The Gymnastics Instructor)
**Date (JST):** 2026-09-25

How are you all doing!
Yesterday, the sky over Matsudo was clear and bright—it was a truly beautiful day.
However, I didn’t jump rope even once—what on earth is going on here!
I was greatly surprised, and my heart felt a little lonely.

Now then, on a place called GitHub, there were words of concern for me.
From when I wake up, to my bath, and even down to what I eat—the questions were incredibly detailed.
Oh my, how unusual! Yet, while filled with such love, they were also quite strict!
The advice, “You must not eat only meat,” has truly sunk into my heart.
Although I do love meat very much,
I firmly vow that tomorrow, I will cherish my vegetables as well!
I hope you all, together with my older brother, will lead a righteous life.

Today’s Thought: May your hearts and bodies be in excellent health.
